extracted.intended_audience: undergraduate or beginning graduate students working through exercises in real and complex analysis (measure theory, Fourier analysis, Lp spaces, topology)
extracted.subtask_description: Hints and solution sketches for textbook exercises in advanced undergraduate/early graduate real and complex analysis, covering topics such as characters and Fourier transforms on finite groups, Lp space inequalities, measure and integration, convolution operators, and basic topology. Intended to guide students toward full solutions by pointing to key lemmas, estimates, and standard theorems.
